title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Full descriptions validated on LinkedIn. Scores measure skill and domain fit.
latest_update: Latest update: September 21, 2026 — 14 title-family searches, 11 remote-hub passes, and 4 reachable-city hybrid passes run; LinkedIn's classic search is degraded (site banner: "gradually retiring classic job search") and returned the same small recycled pool for nearly every query, so coverage is broad but shallow — see method note.

notes_sections.heading: September 21 run — pass audit
items: All 14 default title-family phrases (remote, Canada, past-week filter) run and marked Complete — no CAPTCHA/checkpoint hit. Every phrase returned the identical ~7–9 card "recommended" pool (Tailscale, Midnite, Xsolla, Syntax, Omnissa, FICO, Blair Health, micro1) regardless of keyword text; LinkedIn's own banner states classic job search is being retired, which explains the degraded relevance.

All 11 remote-hub passes (Toronto/GTA, Vancouver, Montréal, Calgary, Ottawa, Edmonton, Waterloo/Kitchener, Halifax, Winnipeg, Québec City, Victoria — remote filter, past-week) run and marked Complete. Mostly the same recycled pool plus a handful of genuinely new listings (AuthZed, Sage Recruiting, Kraken, ClearGov, Ciena Linux Distribution) that were not individually validated this run — see Could not validate.

4 reachable-city hybrid passes (Ottawa, Kingston, Cornwall, Montréal — hybrid filter, no remote keyword, past-week): Ottawa and Montréal returned real result sets (Complete); Kingston and Cornwall returned zero direct matches, LinkedIn fell back to a generic "Jobs you may be interested in" rail (Zero results).

Fully validated (full description opened) this run: Xsolla SRE Monetization, Midnite Senior Platform Engineer, Quantiphi Lead DevOps Engineer, Quantiphi Senior Platform Engineer (GenAI), Avahi AWS Solutions Architect, Omnissa Staff Software Engineer, ANVIL Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Open Systems Technologies DevOps/K8s/SRE Engineer. Syntax, Tailscale, and Ciena carried over from existing applications.md/linkedin.json pipeline records rather than being re-opened.
No employer-site recovery was needed — every candidate posting stayed accessible directly on LinkedIn.

method: Authenticated, read-only LinkedIn search completed September 21, 2026. All 14 default title-family phrases, all 11 remote-hub discovery passes, and all 4 reachable-city hybrid passes from the check-linkedin skill were executed (29 passes total). LinkedIn's classic job search interface is materially degraded — the site's own banner states it is being retired starting September 2026 — and returned the same small pool of ~7-9 'recommended' postings almost regardless of the exact search phrase or location entered; keyword and location targeting could not be verified as effective. As a result, 13 postings received full-description validation and scoring, while 9 additional postings that surfaced repeatedly across passes were not opened this run and are listed under Could not validate rather than guessed at. No CAPTCHA or access block was encountered on any pass. Given the search interface's behavior, this run should be read as a broad but shallow sweep — a materially different result is not expected from re-running the same phrase/location grid again without LinkedIn changing what it serves.
